supersedes.prior_attempt_result: Source and renderer were loaded; querySourceFeatures returned 166 numeric Point features and queryRenderedFeatures returned 27. The screenshot still showed no obvious circles. The report did not include actual layer stack order, per-feature evaluated paint/layout, projected feature positions, or canvas dimensions, so it did not isolate stacking from rendered-symbol visibility.

purpose: Inspect the actual MapLibre render stack and feature-level evaluated circle paint/position for the loaded River layer. This report is read-only diagnostic evidence, not a visual acceptance test.

scope.page_access: Fresh anonymous Browser context; no cookies, credentials, or injected metadata outside the exact frozen Pages plan.
scope.source_access: Live exact-plan Source requests under the existing strict bounded Range, 206, Content-Range, MIME, CORS and byte-budget checks.
scope.vue_map_access: Starting at document.body._vnode, use the same bounded read-only Vue traversal pinned in r2 to read MapView.map. During inspection, call only MapLibre read APIs; make no Vue state writes, map control clicks, zooms, layer visibility changes, synthetic data injections, or extra network calls.

render_inspection_limits.sample_selection: Among the bounded examined point features with finite numeric i_mid, select up to five highest values; ties retain original query order. These samples locate the most visible expected symbols and are diagnostic, not representative validation. Report the full rendered count, examined count/truncation, and numeric i_mid min/max over the examined set.

features.rendered: queryRenderedFeatures counts; this is not a visual pass. MapLibre documents that returned features may have no visible contribution, for example if evaluated opacity or color alpha is zero.
features.evaluated_style: For at most five representative features, record feature.layer.paint and feature.layer.layout as returned by queryRenderedFeatures; MapLibre documents these as evaluated for the current zoom and feature.
features.projected_position: For Point geometries, project the returned source coordinates through map.project and include canvas dimensions to determine whether the symbol center is inside the viewport.
features.source: Retain r2 querySourceFeatures counts, type counts over at most 5000 features, and at most five small property/geometry samples.

observations.console: Existing harness captures console errors and warnings; any console error remains a failure.

interpretation: The ordered stack identifies which basemap layers are above and below the River layer; it does not by itself prove visible contribution.
Evaluated paint plus coordinates/projected pixels distinguish offscreen features, small or transparent symbols, and layer-order hypotheses; screenshots still require human review.
This report can never satisfy or alter the original acceptance gates.
unchanged_gates: Use the exact committed Pages publish plan and immutable Source object plan passed to the existing harness.
Do not intercept or replace Source data, bypass response checks, permit full data GETs, or suppress failed-request errors.
No map or Vue mutations are allowed during inspection; no screenshot or query count is an automatic visual pass.
